listings.name: German Development Cooperation (GIZ) South Africa
listings.current_description: The German Development Cooperation (GIZ) South Africa office in Pretoria has coordinated German-South African development projects since the country office opened in 1996, focusing on peaceful and inclusive societies, sustainable economic development and skills training, and climate and energy transition, including hosting the Secretariat of the Energy Partnership.

listings.name: JAPS Printing (Pty) LTD
listings.current_description: JAPS Printing (Pty) LTD is a family owned and operated printing business in Elardus Park, offering wide format printing of vinyl stickers, banners, canvas prints and signage, plus full colour printing of business cards, flyers and posters, and personalised design and print for small businesses and event planners.

listings.name: JLF Automotive
listings.current_description: JLF Automotive is a mobile mechanic service based in Klerksoord, Akasia, offering engine diagnostics, brake and clutch repairs, battery replacement, tyre services and full vehicle servicing, with technicians who come to the customer's home, office or roadside location and experience across Jaguar, Land Rover, Ford and other makes.

listings.name: Maltech-Africa Business Consultancy & Advisory Services
listings.current_description: Maltech-Africa Business Consultancy & Advisory Services operates as a Zimbabwe-South Africa compliance and trade facilitation hub, supporting entrepreneurs, diaspora investors and community institutions through corporate services, diaspora relocation support, rural development initiatives, digital empowerment programmes, and compliance and accreditation facilitation for businesses operating within and outside South Africa.

listings.name: Midstream College
listings.current_description: Midstream College is a private, dual-medium (Afrikaans and English) school with a Christian ethos inside the secure Midstream Estate; its high school opened its doors in 2007 and wrote its first IEB matric exams in 2009, and the campus includes an auditorium, indoor swimming pool and hockey astroturf.

listings.name: Minit Print Centurion
listings.current_description: Minit Print Centurion, part of a printing franchise established in 1971, offers both litho printing for large-volume runs and digital printing for smaller, quick-turnaround jobs from its Byls Bridge Promenade Centre branch, backed by an in-house design department producing business cards, flyers, brochures, posters, company profiles and catalogues.

listings.name: Modic • Creative Digital Agency
listings.current_description: Modic • Creative Digital Agency, formed in 2022 from the merger of McCrea Media and ModuTech, is based in Centurion and offers digital marketing services including SEO, Google Ads, social media marketing, video and animation, working with clients across South Africa as well as the United States and Ireland.

listings.name: NIFDAR CONSULTING SA
listings.current_description: NIFDAR Consulting SA is a public health management consulting firm based in Woodhill Golf Estate, helping clients deliver projects on HIV/AIDS, TB, COVID-19, malaria and other infectious and non-communicable diseases across Africa. It also has an affiliated public benefit organisation focused on health access for underserved communities.

listings.name: Play Town
listings.current_description: Play Town is an indoor pretend-play and party venue in Hennopspark featuring ten themed playrooms linked by a decorated roadway track for bike riding, a pirate-ship-shaped jungle gym with slides and an obstacle course, a rock-climbing wall, and around 250 square metres of trampolines split by age group.

listings.name: Pretoria Arms
listings.current_description: Pretoria Arms is a firearms and outdoor-gear retailer at Montana Boulevard Lifestyle Centre in Magalieskruin, in operation since 1974 and originally a gunsmithing operation specialising in competition-pistol accurizing; it now stocks firearms, ammunition and optics, runs an underground 25m/50m/100m shooting range, and offers firearm competency training.

listings.name: Python System Design
listings.current_description: Python System Design was established in 1991, originally doing hardware and software development for the defence industry before shifting into outsourced corporate IT services, which it now provides nationally from its Centurion and Cape Town offices, covering backup, cloud, cyber security, hardware, internet services, software, support and VoIP.

listings.name: Q Tyres
listings.current_description: Q Tyres is a black-owned company in Klerksoord specialising in tyre sales, rim manufacture and repair for the mining and industrial sectors, supplying new tyres, rim repairs and polyurethane wheel units, backed by owners with a combined 135-plus years of experience in the OTR tyre and rim industry.

listings.name: Q Tyres (Pty) Ltd
listings.current_description: Q Tyres (Pty) Ltd is a black-owned tyre company operating from Klerksoord, Pretoria, specialising in tyre sales, rim manufacture and repair for the mining sector, offering new tyres, rim repairs and polyurethane wheel units, with owners bringing a combined 135-plus years of OTR tyre and rim industry experience.

listings.name: QABULA HOLDINGS PTY LTD
listings.current_description: Qabula Holdings is a Pretoria-based sourcing, freight and logistics company established in 2015, offering freight forwarding, customs clearance, supply chain management and air, sea and road freight services, with a team bringing more than 15 years of combined experience serving clients in the mining, chemical and industrial sectors.

listings.name: Quanticost
listings.current_description: Quanticost is a quantity surveying and construction cost consultancy operating from Lynnwood Manor, formed in October 1999 through the formalised working association of established quantity surveying practices in Pretoria, Johannesburg and Polokwane. The firm focuses on reducing the financial risk of developments and adding value for project participants.

listings.name: Ruiter Gaming & Electronics
listings.current_description: Ruiter Gaming & Electronics is a games-console and PC repair specialist in Villieria, servicing PlayStation, Xbox and Nintendo consoles, gaming PCs and laptops, and controllers, alongside selling consoles, PCs and accessories. Established in 2020, the business offers 3-6 month repair warranties and has completed over 7,000 repairs.

listings.name: SL Accounting Services (Pty) Ltd
listings.current_description: SL Accounting Services (Pty) Ltd is an accounting firm in Clubview, Centurion, offering bookkeeping, tax compliance and advisory, payroll and statutory reporting, CIPC company secretarial services and outsourced accounting for small and medium businesses across Centurion, Pretoria and Midrand, led by a SAICA-registered accountant and SARS-registered tax practitioner.

listings.name: Super Rafts
listings.current_description: Super Rafts is a Pretoria-based construction firm, established in 2003, that specialises in raft foundation design and construction, including layout plans, reinforcement detailing, NHBRC documentation, council approvals and engineer inspections, and has built more than a million square metres of raft foundations across Gauteng and the Western Cape.

listings.name: taxichoice.
listings.current_description: Taxichoice is a specialised intermediary in South Africa's minibus taxi industry, connecting financial institutions, taxi associations and operators to verify membership, assess route profitability and facilitate compliant vehicle finance; it also runs a Taxi Rescue recovery service and the Zola Taxi Sales dealership, based in Ashlea Gardens, Pretoria.

listings.name: THE COMPANIES TRIBUNAL
listings.current_description: The Companies Tribunal is a statutory agency of the Department of Trade, Industry and Competition, based at the dti Campus in Sunnyside, Pretoria, that resolves company disputes such as directorship and name disputes under the Companies Act through adjudication and alternative dispute resolution, with jurisdiction across South Africa.

listings.name: Universal Coolers
listings.current_description: Universal Coolers is a heat-exchange and cooling-systems specialist in Raslouw established in 1999, manufacturing engine and transmission oil coolers, intercoolers, charge-air coolers and aluminium header tanks, and offering intercooler and radiator re-coring and testing plus custom 3D CAD-designed cooling solutions for the motorsport, mining, aviation and earthmoving sectors.

listings.name: Africa Disability Alliance
listings.current_description: Africa Disability Alliance is a Pretoria-based non-profit organisation advancing the rights, inclusion and empowerment of persons with disabilities across Africa through advocacy and capacity-building, established in 2003 and helping shape policies including the UN Convention on the Rights of Persons with Disabilities and the African Union's Africa Disability Protocol.

listings.name: BJK Industries (Pty) Ltd Pretoria
listings.current_description: BJK Industries is a Silvertondale-based producer and distributor of animal proteins, fats, oils, minerals and frozen meat by-products for the pet food, livestock feed and aqua feed industries, operating a 600-ton cold store, two warehouses totalling 1,500 square metres, and its own BJK Transport fleet for northern distribution.

listings.name: Bravura Group
listings.current_description: Bravura Group is an accounting, tax and legal services firm based in Kameeldrift East, Pretoria, offering monthly accounting, VAT and tax returns, payroll (PAYE/UIF/SDL), COIDA, HR and labour law support, deeds and trust setup, and retirement and insurance planning for individuals and businesses in Pretoria and Centurion.

listings.name: Buzaphi Construction (Pty) Ltd
listings.current_description: Buzaphi Construction (Pty) Ltd is a Monument Park-based civil engineering and building contractor working on roads, stormwater, sewer and water infrastructure and wastewater treatment facilities, plus school and social development building projects and plant hire, with clients including the City of Tshwane and the Department of Water and Sanitation.

listings.name: Calmex Mobile
listings.current_description: Calmex Mobile is an ICASA-licensed operator providing digital infrastructure across South Africa built around three pillars - connectivity (telecommunications infrastructure), payments (merchant acquiring and SoftPOS) and mobility (transport and fleet management) - plus a consumer "Super App", serving public transport, government, enterprise, retail and events clients from Doringkloof, Centurion.

listings.name: Car Service City - Wonderboom
listings.current_description: Car Service City - Wonderboom is a branch of the Car Service City vehicle repair chain, based at Wonderboom Carvenience Shopping Centre. It has been run by the same owner since 2013 and offers major and minor servicing, repairs, and a 62-point safety check on all makes and models.

listings.name: Citton Cars Menlyn
listings.current_description: Citton Cars Menlyn is a used-vehicle dealership with over 30 years' experience buying and selling pre-owned cars; every vehicle undergoes an independent Bosch 160-point inspection and comes with a 2-month/3,000km warranty, and the dealership also offers vehicle financing, trade-in evaluations, car insurance and on-site Bosch Car Service.

listings.name: Cresco Project Finance
listings.current_description: A financial advisory firm providing transaction advisory, project finance advisory, financial modelling, export credit agency and CPRI advisory, programme management office and decarbonisation and energy strategy services to clients in the energy, infrastructure, mining, health and real estate sectors across Africa, with offices in South Africa, Mauritius and Portugal.

listings.name: DHI South Africa Pretoria Office
listings.current_description: DHI is an international water and environmental engineering consultancy best known for its "MIKE Powered by DHI" software suite (including MIKE 21/3, MIKE+ and FEFLOW) used for water resource, coastal, port and water-treatment modelling and planning; its South Africa office is based in the Route 21 Business Park.

listings.name: J R Kopano Engineering
listings.current_description: J R Kopano Engineering is a manufacturing engineering firm in Rosslyn that has operated for around 25 years, producing press tools, jigs and fixtures along with tooling for aluminium extrusion, scaffolding, glass and security fencing, and also manufactures stainless steel products such as espetada stands for the hospitality industry.

listings.name: Maizey Plastics - Pretoria East
listings.current_description: This Maizey Plastics branch is part of a South African plastics manufacturer founded in 1950, distributing engineering, industrial and commercial plastics as well as signage materials, digital print media, aluminium profiles, POP/POS display systems and heat transfer films, and it trades weekdays from 08:00 to 17:00.

listings.name: Maxi Factory
listings.current_description: Maxi Factory has manufactured bricks at its Klerksoord plant north of Pretoria since 2004, growing into a leading maxi brick and cement stock producer with an output of around 160,000 cement stocks and 80,000 maxi bricks per day, all made to SANS 1215 and SANS 1058 specifications.

listings.name: Meat 2 Oceans Market
listings.current_description: Meat 2 Oceans Market is a butchery and fish market in Marabastad; the family-run business was founded in 2009 by two brothers-in-law with over twenty years of industry experience, offering a wide selection of fresh and frozen fish alongside butchery products for chefs, small business owners and the public.

listings.name: Mediro ICT
listings.current_description: Mediro ICT, based in Kosmosdal, is an enterprise technology partner specialising in application performance monitoring, enterprise service management, digital employee experience and automated software testing, alongside business intelligence, infrastructure and unified security services for banks, financial services firms and other organisations across South Africa and the wider Sub-Saharan region.

listings.name: Mindset Mining Consultants (PTY) LTD
listings.current_description: Mindset Mining Consultants is a 51% Black-owned, Level 2 BBBEE mining engineering and consulting firm based in Erasmusrand, specialising in coal mining evaluations that cover geology, planning, design and financial analysis, with projects completed for clients across South Africa, the rest of Africa, the UK, Russia and the USA.

listings.name: Morgan Holdings
listings.current_description: Morgan Holdings, based in Brummeria, Pretoria, is a diversified group whose interests include Morgan Beef, a leading meat supplier, processor and exporter in Sub-Saharan Africa, red wine production, and the related Morgan Cargo logistics business offering sea and air freight forwarding and contract logistics from branches across South Africa.

listings.name: One 85 in Vinko
listings.current_description: One 85 in Vinko is a self-catering flatlet with a separate entrance on the owner's Sinoville property, close to the Sefako Makgatho highway, Montana Hospital and schools including Overkruin, Northridge and Stephanus Roos Primary. It sleeps two guests in an open-plan unit with a kitchenette, free WiFi and DStv.

listings.name: PPC Hercules Factory
listings.current_description: PPC Hercules Factory is an integrated cement plant in Hermanstad that traces its roots to 1892, when it began operating as Eerste Fabrieken Zement, making it the first Portland cement manufacturer in Africa. It remains a major cement production site supplying much of the cement used across South Africa.

listings.name: PRBB Trailers - Factory
listings.current_description: PRBB Trailers - Factory in Donkerhoek manufactures Tautliner, Flatdeck and Side Tipper trailers, having grown from its roots as a trailer manufacturer founded in Piet Retief, Mpumalanga in 1969 into one of the fastest-growing players in the industry, with all trailers now manufactured and delivered from this Pretoria facility.

listings.name: Ultimate Powder Coaters
listings.current_description: Ultimate Powder Coaters is a powder coating, sandblasting and metal fabrication specialist in Koedoespoort offering over 4,000 colour options plus chemical paint stripping, custom fabrication and welding from a full-service facility with large-capacity ovens and a dedicated blast chamber, and has been operating for more than 10 years.

listings.name: Uniqon Developers (Pty) Ltd
listings.current_description: Uniqon Developers (Pty) Ltd is a Pretoria property development group established in 1985, building residential estates -- sectional-title apartments, simplex units and townhouses -- as well as retail centres, with a completed portfolio of more than 7,895 residential units across suburbs including Six Fountains, Olympus, Montana and Brooklyn.

listings.name: Waldick Attorneys
listings.current_description: Waldick Attorneys is a full-service law firm in Clubview formed in 2015 through the merger of Weyer Waldick & Willemse Attorneys and JVR Attorneys, practising corporate law, liquidations and business rescue, litigation, labour law, construction and mining law, as well as family law, wills and estates, and criminal law.

listings.name: WWISE - Head Office
listings.current_description: WWISE (World Wide Industrial & Systems Engineers) is a Centurion-based ISO consulting and implementation firm established in 2009, providing ISO certification support, auditing and gap analysis, training and learnerships in engineering, finance and business, and continual-improvement programmes such as Lean Manufacturing and Six Sigma, serving clients across 23 countries.

listings.name: Amber Energy
listings.current_description: Amber Energy is a solar and energy solutions provider based in Irene, Centurion, offering energy audits and the design, build and maintenance of solar photovoltaic systems -- including backup, hybrid, grid-tied and off-grid setups using Victron and Sunsynk inverters -- for homes and businesses, with over 1,000 installations completed.

listings.name: Bevonkte Projects SOLAR
listings.current_description: Bevonkte Projects SOLAR, with more than 17 years' experience, is a Pretoria North solar and electrical company offering turnkey EPC solar installations, electrical compliance certificates, SSEG reports and maintenance, having delivered systems from 105kW hybrid installations to 375kW commercial grid-tied plants and farm-based solar with battery backup and irrigation control.

listings.name: Budget Plants
listings.current_description: Budget Plants is a nursery on Stellenberg Road in Equestria, Pretoria, originally opened as R3 and R5 Nursery in 1999 before evolving into Budget Plants and Landscaping. It grows much of its own stock and sells flowers, plants, trees, seedlings, herbs, pots and gardening accessories, and hosts occasional gardening workshops.

listings.name: Cadcon Steel Construction & Engineering
listings.current_description: Cadcon (Pty) Ltd, trading as Cadcon Steel Construction & Engineering, is a structural steelwork company established in 1987 offering detailing, fabrication, corrosion protection and erection of structural steel and platework, with a monthly production capacity of around 600 tons, and has worked on projects across South Africa and neighbouring countries.

listings.name: Cartridge Hyper Elardus Park
listings.current_description: Cartridge Hyper is a South African retail chain, established in 2003, specializing in original and generic inkjet and laser printer cartridges, toner, drum units and printheads for brands including HP, Canon, Samsung, Epson, Lexmark, Oki and Brother; this store is located at The Park Shopping Centre in Elardus Park, Pretoria.

listings.name: CCL GLOBAL
listings.current_description: CCL Global is a health and sports industry company based in Annlin Business Park, Pretoria, providing products and technology for injury prevention and recovery, and working with South African sports brands including the Springboks, Bulls, Lions, and Stormers. The company also operates branches in Namibia, Taiwan, and the United Kingdom.
